messages:
alex: quick thread — noticed several enterprise tenants auto-falling back to v1 during the v2 rollout. dashboard shows a generic 'compat mode' banner but no per-tenant counts. this is causing support churn. any ideas for a low-effort affordance + telemetry we can ship before EOW?
rachel: yikes. are these true fallbacks (runtime mismatch) or header-negotiation issues?
ben: metric I saw: `route.fallback.v1.count` spiked ~3x after the 03:00 deploy. traces show `X-Client-Version` missing on many requests.
maya: could be some internal SDKs still sending old headers. we should surface last-successful-version per tenant in console + quick link to sample traces. low-effort = add a column in tenant table and a CTA to download a 1-click probe curl.
alex: +1. UX idea: when fallback rate > 0.5% show a yellow banner with exact count and "Investigate request samples" button. don't redirect to product docs.
sam: ops note — make sure the banner only appears to tenant admins (not org-wide). also tie banner to an alert in pagerduty for SRE if rate > 5% sustained for 10m.
rachel: telemetry: add a tag `fallback_reason` (e.g., header_missing, version_mismatch, quota_overflow) to the existing metric so we can break down spikes. that won't require schema changes to downstream metrics consumers if we add it as a label.
ben: agree. quick prod-safe probe we can add today: a sampling path that returns request headers and the route decision. something like:
```
GET /internal/probe?sample=1
Response: { route: "v2", fallback: true, reason: "header_missing", headers: { ... } }
```
we can gate it to internal tokens.
maya: console copy matter: avoid "deprecated" language in the tenant banner, use "compatibility fallback" + one-liner: "Requests are being routed to a compatible runtime (v1). Click to inspect samples and upgrade clients."
alex: +1 on copy. also need a quick support playbook: 1) show tenant admin console 2) click inspect -> download curl samples 3) upgrade SDK or set `X-Client-Version: 2` header.
sam: ops checklist for rollout:
- add `fallback_reason` label to metrics
- expose tenant fallback counts in console table (default hidden col)
- add banner + CTA with inspect modal
- implement probe endpoint behind internal auth
- PD alert if rate > 5% for 10m
I'll own PD alert + probe gating. who takes metrics + console changes?
rachel: I can take metrics + backend label. estimate 2 dev-days.
maya: I'll do the console UI and copy. 1.5 days.
ben: I'll add the inspect modal backend and the sample-curl generator. 1 day.
deploy-bot: deploy queued by alex for canary to staging (build/2304).
alex: timeline check — start work today, merge by Thursday, staging canary Friday, prod rollout next Tue. also add a short blurb to product-notices so support teams know the new banner.
maya: I'll draft the blurb and ping @support once staging looks good.
ben: for instrumentation: please ensure the `fallback_reason` also gets attached to traces (span attr) so SRE can pivot fast.
sam: noted. after we ship, we should run a 72h sampling job to classify fallback reasons across tenants and share a short postmortem if a big customer is impacted.
alex: thanks team — I'll make a GH meta-issue with the action items and link this thread. keep updates here. :thumbsup:
